rows.grounds: compound adjective describing the syllable as endowed with three powers
repeated compound adjective emphasizing the syllable's constant endowment with three powers

items.question: What perpetual endowment with the three powers characterizes the syllable addressed to the goddess?
premises: The syllable is described as accompanied by three powers.
This accompaniment is affirmed twice in direct address to the goddess.
The quality is stated to hold always.
items.inference: Therefore, the syllable addressed to the goddess is perpetually and emphatically endowed with the three powers.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the three powers is not named in this unit.
items.plain_english: O goddess, the syllable is accompanied by the three powers, accompanied by the three powers always.
